name: Gunnison River — Gunnison Gorge
gaugeName: Gunnison River below Gunnison Tunnel, CO (USGS 09128000)
blurb: Hike-in wilderness gorge: boats are carried down the Chukar Trail; Class II–IV to the North Fork confluence. Wilderness permit required.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Boats carried ~1 mile down the Chukar Trail. Wilderness permit and fee required; BLM limit is 3 days/2 nights. Mileage: BLM Gunnison Gorge NCA brochure.

notices.title: Wilderness permit
notices.text: A Gunnison Gorge Wilderness permit and fee are required. The published limit is three days / two nights. Confirm current fees with BLM.

notices.title: Access limitation
notices.text: BLM: boats and gear carried ~1 mile down the Chukar Trail; no carts or wheeled devices in the wilderness; access road often requires 4WD.

putInAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 89961
putInAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 89961 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 1 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: BLM; Gunnison Gorge Wilderness permit/fee required; boats carried ~1 mile down the Chukar Trail from the trailhead. (BLM Gunnison Gorge NCA brochure, https://www.blm.gov/sites/blm.gov/files/uploads/programs_national-conservation-lands_colorado_gunnison-gorge_NCA_brochure_Low.pdf).

takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 90635
takeOutAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 90635 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 46 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: BLM day-use and boat ramp at the North Fork confluence. (BLM Gunnison Gorge river map, https://www.blm.gov/sites/blm.gov/files/docs/2021-01/final.2020%20river%20map%20for%20web_0.pdf).

mapAuditNote: Audited 2026-10-26. Every endpoint is an exact managing-agency facility point within 150 m of the USGS NHDPlus centreline.
